Title: BB15-MK3
Product Description:
The BB15-MK3 is a compact single-15 self-powered vented direct-radiating subwoofer that delivers room-shaking low end from a small box. Built around a neodymium woofer with 2,500W of amplification, it is designed to pair with smaller tops such as the DiaMon-MK3.

  • 15-inch neodymium woofer with 4.5-inch voice coil

  • 2,500W RMS Class-D amplifier

  • CNC-machined 15mm birch plywood cabinet; IP65 connectors

Title: SSP215-MK3
Product Description:
The SSP215-MK3 is a twin-15 self-powered vented direct-radiating subwoofer with premium 96kHz DSP and five-stage driver protection, delivering high-output low frequencies to 35Hz.

  • Dual 15-inch long-excursion neodymium woofers, 4-inch voice coils

  • High-output amplification with auto-sensing 90-250V supply

  • 96kHz DSP with five-stage driver protection; IP65 connectors

Title: SSP218-MK3
Product Description:
The SSP218-MK3 is a twin-18 self-powered vented direct-radiating subwoofer tuned for flat response to 30Hz, driven by two discrete amplifiers.

  • Dual 18-inch neodymium woofers, 4-inch voice coils

  • Two discrete amplifiers (5,000W, auto-sensing 90-250V)

  • Tuned for flat response to 30Hz

Title: ZV28-MK3
Product Description:
The ZV28-MK3 is an extended-depth vented subwoofer with dual long-excursion 18-inch drivers tuned very low for explosive sub-bass down to 23Hz.

  • Dual 18-inch long-excursion neodymium woofers

  • Extended-depth vented design tuned to 23Hz

  • 18mm Baltic birch plywood cabinet

Title: SV9-MK3
Product Description:
The SV9-MK3 is a 2-way single-9 self-powered vented direct-radiating full-range loudspeaker small enough to carry in one hand, with a birch plywood enclosure and 96kHz DSP.

  • 2-way single 9-inch full-range top, ultra-portable

  • 1200W asymmetrical Class-D amplifier

  • 96kHz DSP; IP65 connectors; 110-240V global power

Title: DiaMon-MK3
Product Description:
The DiaMon-MK3 is a 2-way single-12 coaxial point-source mid-high loudspeaker in the smallest possible cabinet, designed to deliver loud, clear mids and highs and pair with subwoofers for the low end.

  • 2-way coaxial point-source 12-inch top

  • 1200W Class-D amplifier (900W LF / 300W HF)

  • Tweeter fires through the centre of the 12-inch woofer (coaxial)

Title: DV12-MK3
Product Description:
The DV12-MK3 is a 2-way single-12 self-powered vented direct-radiating full-range top with wide, consistent horizontal coverage and tight vertical control. Preset 1 runs full-range to 40Hz, with further presets to integrate with subwoofers.

  • 2-way single 12-inch full-range top

  • 3200W Class-D (2400W woofer / 800W compression driver)

  • 120 x 20 degree coverage; full-range to 40Hz in Preset 1

Title: AT312-MK3
Product Description:
The AT312-MK3 is a 3-way triple-12 self-powered direct-radiating coaxial point-source full-range loudspeaker - a vented LF section, sealed mid section and coaxially mounted HF section - for massive output and clarity at large-scale events.

  • 3-way triple 12-inch coaxial point-source top

  • 4000W amplification (2400W woofers / 800W mid / 800W HF)

  • Coaxially mounted compression driver for point-source coherence

Title: CCM12-MK3
Product Description:
The CCM12-MK3 is a 12-inch bi-amped coaxial wedge monitor with presets for full-range and mid-high operation, an asymmetrical Class-D amplifier, 96kHz DSP and IP65-rated connectors.

  • 12-inch coaxial powered wedge monitor

  • 1200W asymmetrical Class-D (900W woofer / 300W HF)

  • 96kHz DSP; full-range and mid-high presets

Title: Stackatoa
Product Description:
The Stackatoa (Stack-a-Toa) is a vertically stacked system combining the Kraken quad-21 subwoofer, the Makara double-21 subwoofer and the Krakatoa 4-way point-source loudspeaker, for maximum SPL from a minimal floor footprint. It was awarded Best in Show at 2026 NAMM.

  • Phase-aligned stack of Kraken, Makara and Krakatoa

  • Six 21-inch subs, four 18-inch woofers, one 18-inch low-mid, one coaxial mid-high horn

  • Roughly 12 sq ft footprint; 10 ft 4 in tall
